75129.commentary: (SNPa) sot'āvadhān'ūpanis'ūpapanne'ti sotaodahanena ca maggaphalānaṃ upanissayena ca upapanne.

examples.text: evam'pi yo vedagu bhāvit'atto, bahussuto hoti avedhadhammo, so kho pare nijjhapaye pajānaṃ, sot'āvadhān'ūpanis'ūpapanne.

75130.meaning1: who has understood the teaching; who has comprehended the reality
75130.commentary: (SNPa) tāya paṭipattiyā paṭivedhavasena viññātadhammo so maggaphalanibbānappabhedaṃ lok'uttarasukhaṃ labhetha adhigaccheyya pāpuṇeyyā'ti arahattanikūṭena desanaṃ samāpesī'ti. (VVa) viññātadhammā'ti viññātasāsanadhammā, paṭividdhacatusaccadhammā'ti attho.

examples.text: tasmā have sappurisaṃ bhajetha, medhāvinañ'c'eva bahussutañ'ca, aññāya atthaṃ paṭipajjamāno, viññātadhammo sa sukhaṃ labhethā'ti.
yā sā ahu mayhaṃ sakhī bhadante, saṅghassa kāresi mahāvihāraṃ, viññātadhammā sā adāsi dānaṃ, uppannā nimmānaratīsu devesu.

75131.meaning1: knowing the discrimination of mental phenomena; understanding the evaluation of mental processes
75131.commentary: (SNPa) dhammavinicchayaṃ jānāti idaṃ udayañāṇaṃ idaṃ vayañāṇan'ti dhammavinicchayaññū, evarūpo assa.

examples.text: dhamm'ārāmo dhammarato, dhamme ṭhito dhammavinicchayaññū, n'ev'ācare dhammasandosavādaṃ, tacchehi nīyetha subhāsitehi.

75132.meaning1: statement degrading the Dhamma; disparaging the teaching
75132.commentary: (SNPa) atha y'āyaṃ rājakath'ādi-tiracchānakathā taruṇavipassakassa bahiddhārūp'ādīsu abhinandan'uppādanena taṃ samathavipassanādhammaṃ sandūseti, tasmā dhammasandosavādo'ti vuccati, taṃ n'ev'ācare dhammasandosavādaṃ

examples.text: dhamm'ārāmo dhammarato, dhamme ṭhito dhammavinicchayaññū, n'ev'ācare dhammasandosavādaṃ, tacchehi nīyetha subhāsitehi.

75138.meaning1: without conceit; (or) not intoxicated (by health, youth, life, etc.)
75138.commentary: (SNPa) hitvā ca ārogyamad'ādivigamā vītamadena cittavikkhep'ābhāvā ṭhitattena caritabbaṃ.

examples.text: hassaṃ jappaṃ paridevaṃ padosaṃ, māyākataṃ kuhanaṃ giddhi mānaṃ, sārambhaṃ kakkasaṃ kasāvañ'ca mucchaṃ, hitvā care vītamado ṭhit'atto.

75139.meaning1: with knowing as the core; having understanding as the essence
75139.commentary: (SNPa) tass'attho, yāni h'etāni samathavipassanā-paṭisaṃyuttāni subhāsitāni, tesaṃ vijānanaṃ sāro. yadi viññātāni sādhu, atha saddamattam'eva gahitaṃ, na kiñci kataṃ hoti, yena etāni sutamayena ñāṇena viññāyan'ti

examples.text: viññātasārāni subhāsitāni, sutañ'ca viññātasamādhisāraṃ, na tassa paññā ca sutañ'ca vaḍḍhati, yo sāhaso hoti naro pamatto.

75140.meaning1: understanding that perfect peace of mind is essential; knowing the importance of meditative stability
75140.commentary: (SNPa) etañ'ca sutamayañāṇaṃ viññātasamādhisāraṃ, tesu viññātesu dhammesu yo samādhi cittass'āvikkhepo tath'attāya paṭipatti, ayam'assa sāro. na hi vijānanamatten'eva koci attho sijjhati.

examples.text: viññātasārāni subhāsitāni, sutañ'ca viññātasamādhisāraṃ, na tassa paññā ca sutañ'ca vaḍḍhati, yo sāhaso hoti naro pamatto.

75141.meaning1: taught by the Noble One; preached by the Buddha
75141.commentary: (SNPa) ariyappavedito dhammo nāma samathavipassanādhammo. eko'pi hi buddho samathavipassanādhammaṃ adesetvā parinibbuto nāma n'atthi.

examples.text: dhamme ca ye ariyapavedite ratā, anuttarā te vacasā manasā kammunā ca, te santisoraccasamādhisaṇṭhitā, sutassa paññāya ca sāram'ajjhagū'ti.

75142.meaning1: established in calm, kindness and meditative composure; founded on peace, gentleness and stillness
75142.commentary: (SNPa) evaṃ parisuddhasīlā te santisoraccasamādhisaṇṭhitā, sutassa paññāya ca sāram'ajjhagū, ye ariyappavedite dhamme ratā, te na kevalaṃ vāc'ādīhi anuttarā honti, apica kho pana santisoracce samādhimhi ca saṇṭhitā hutvā sutassa paññāya ca sāram'ajjhagū adhigatā icc'eva veditabbā. āsaṃsāyaṃ bhūtavacanaṃ. santī'ti nibbānaṃ, soraccan'ti sundare ratabhāvena yathābhūtapaṭivedhikā paññā, santiyā soraccan'ti santisoraccaṃ, nibbān'ārammaṇāya maggapaññāy'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. samādhī'ti taṃsampayutto'va maggasamādhi.

examples.text: dhamme ca ye ariyapavedite ratā, anuttarā te vacasā manasā kammunā ca, te santisoraccasamādhisaṇṭhitā, sutassa paññāya ca sāram'ajjhagū'ti.

75143.meaning1: obtained the essence; got the essential; reached the heart
75143.commentary: (SNPa) evaṃ parisuddhasīlā te santisoraccasamādhisaṇṭhitā, sutassa paññāya ca sāram'ajjhagū, ye ariyappavedite dhamme ratā, te na kevalaṃ vāc'ādīhi anuttarā honti, apica kho pana santisoracce samādhimhi ca saṇṭhitā hutvā sutassa paññāya ca sāram'ajjhagū adhigatā icc'eva veditabbā. āsaṃsāyaṃ bhūtavacanaṃ.

examples.text: dhamme ca ye ariyapavedite ratā, anuttarā te vacasā manasā kammunā ca, te santisoraccasamādhisaṇṭhitā, sutassa paññāya ca sāram'ajjhagū'ti.

75144.commentary: (SNPa) evaṃ vutte āyasmā rāhulo n'āhaṃ bhagavā nīcapuriso viya saṃvāsahetu mānaṃ vā madaṃ vā karomī'ti dīpento imaṃ paṭigāthamāha n'āhaṃ abhiṇhasaṃvāsā'ti.

examples.text: kacci abhiṇhasaṃvāsā, n'āvajānāsi paṇḍitaṃ, ukkādhāro manussānaṃ, kacci apacito tayā.

75145.commentary: (SNPa) kiṃ kāraṇaṃ? mā lokaṃ punarāgami. etesu hi taṇhaṃ karonto taṇhāya ākaḍḍhiyamāno puna'pi imaṃ lokaṃ āgacchati. so tvaṃ etesu taṇhaṃ m'ākāsi, evaṃ sante na puna imaṃ lokaṃ āgamissasī'ti.

examples.text: cīvare piṇḍapāte ca, paccaye sayan'āsane, etesu taṇhaṃ m'ākāsi, mā lokaṃ punarāgami.

75146.meaning1: connected with passion; to do with desire

examples.text: nigrodhakappo iti tassa nāmaṃ, tayā kataṃ bhagavā brāhmaṇassa, so taṃ namassaṃ acari muty'apekkho, āraddhavīriyo daḷhadhammadassī.

examples.text: nigrodhakappo iti tassa nāmaṃ, tayā kataṃ bhagavā brāhmaṇassa, so taṃ namassaṃ acari muty'apekkho, āraddhavīriyo daḷhadhammadassī.

75168.meaning1: for which purpose; for whatever benefit

examples.text: yadatthikaṃ brahmacariyaṃ acarī, kappāyano kacci'ssa taṃ amoghaṃ, nibbāyi so ādu saupādiseso, yathā vimutto ahu taṃ suṇoma.
acchecchi taṇhaṃ idha nāmarūpe, kaṇhassa sotaṃ dīgharatt'ānusayitaṃ, atāri jātiṃ maraṇaṃ asesaṃ, icc'abravī bhagavā pañcaseṭṭho.
rañño'haṃ pahito dūto, korabyassa yasassino, atthaṃ dhammañ'ca pucchesi, iccabravi yudhiṭṭhilo, taṃ tvaṃ atthañ'ca dhammañ'ca, vidhur'akkhāhi pucchito.

75170.meaning1: leader of the group of five; (or) foremost in the five (faculties)
75170.commentary: (SNPa) icc'abravī bhagavā pañcaseṭṭho'ti vaṅg'īsena puṭṭho bhagavā etadavoca pañcannaṃ paṭhamasissānaṃ pañcavaggiyānaṃ seṭṭho, pañcahi vā saddh'ādīhi indriyehi, sīl'ādīhi vā dhammakkhandhehi ativisiṭṭhehi cakkhūhi ca seṭṭho'ti saṅgītikārānam'ev'idaṃ vacanaṃ.

examples.text: acchecchi taṇhaṃ idha nāmarūpe, kaṇhassa sotaṃ dīgharatt'ānusayitaṃ atāri jātiṃ maraṇaṃ asesaṃ icc'abravī bhagavā pañcaseṭṭho.

tassa avassuta-kāyakamm'antassa avassuta-vacīkamm'antassa avassuta-manokamm'antassa kāyakammam'pi pūtikaṃ hoti, vacīkammam'pi pūtikaṃ hoti, manokammam'pi pūtikaṃ hoti. tassa pūti-kāyakamm'antassa pūti-vacīkamm'antassa pūti-manokamm'antassa na bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti, na bhaddikā kālaṅ'kiriyā.

75173.synonym: parisuddha, visada, vītaraja, saṃsuddha, suci, sucibhūta, sucīmant, suddha, suddhika
75173.commentary: (MNa) lūkhabhāvan'ti cokkhabhāvaṃ, visuddhibhāvaṃ detī'ti evaṃ sammatā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: yassa maṅgalā samūhatā, uppātā supinā ca lakkhaṇā ca, so maṅgaladosavippahīno, sammā so loke paribbajeyya.

75175.meaning1: given up the fault of superstitions; abandoned the error of (belief in) omens
75175.commentary: (SNPa) so maṅgaladosavippahīno'ti aṭṭhatiṃsa mahāmaṅgalāni ṭhapetvā avasesā maṅgaladosā nāma. yassa pan'ete maṅgal'ādayo samūhatā, so maṅgaladosavippahīno hoti. atha vā maṅgalānañ'ca uppāt'ādidosānañ'ca pahīnattā maṅgaladosavippahīno hoti, na maṅgal'ādīhi suddhiṃ pacceti ariyamaggassa adhigatattā.

examples.text: yassa maṅgalā samūhatā, uppātā supinā ca lakkhaṇā ca, so maṅgaladosavippahīno, sammā so loke paribbajeyya.

75176.synonym: apekkhamāna, abhipatthayanta, nikāmayamāna, patthayanta, patthayamāna, patthayāna

examples.text: vacasā manasā ca kammunā ca, aviruddho sammā viditvā dhammaṃ, nibbānapada-abhipatthayāno, sammā so loke paribbajeyya.

75177.grammar: pr, caus of na uṇṇamati, neg, intrans
75177.meaning1: is not haughty; does not become arrogant; is not conceited
75177.meaningLit: does not cause to bend up
75177.construction:
na + ud + ṇame + ti
na + uṇṇameti

examples.text: yo vandati man'ti n'uṇṇameyya, akkuṭṭho'pi na sandhiyetha bhikkhu, laddhā parabhojanaṃ na majje, sammā so loke paribbajeyya.

75178.meaning1: is haughty; becomes arrogant; is conceited
75178.commentary: (NIDD1) na unnameyya pasaṃsito bhikkhū'ti. idh'ekacce bhikkhū pasaṃsanti jātiyā vā gottena vā… unnatiṃ na kareyya unnamaṃ na kareyya mānaṃ na kareyya thambhaṃ na kareyya, na tena mānaṃ janeyya na tena thaddho assa patthaddho paggahitasiro'ti, na unnameyya pasaṃsito bhikkhu.

examples.text: nindāya nappavedheyya, na uṇṇameyya pasaṃsito bhikkhu, lobhaṃ saha macchariyena, kodhaṃ pesuṇiyañ'ca panudeyya.

75179.grammar: pr, caus of na unnamati, neg, intrans
75179.meaning1: is not haughty; does not become arrogant; is not conceited
75179.meaningLit: does not cause to bend up
75179.construction:
na + ud + name + ti
na + unnameti

examples.text: yo vandati man'ti n'unnameyya, akkuṭṭho'pi na sandhiyetha bhikkhu, laddhā parabhojanaṃ na majje, sammā so loke paribbajeyya.

75180.meaning1: food from others; meal from another
75180.commentary: (SNPa) laddhā parabhojanaṃ na majje'ti parehi dinnaṃ saddhādeyyaṃ labhitvā ahaṃ ñāto yasassī lābhī'ti na majjeyya.

examples.text: yo vandati man'ti n'uṇṇameyya, akkuṭṭho'pi na sandhiyetha bhikkhu, laddhā parabhojanaṃ na majje, sammā so loke paribbajeyya.

75181.grammar: prp of na āsīsati, irreg, neg, trans (+acc)
75181.meaning1: not desiring; not wishing to get; not expecting
75181.commentary: (SNPa) so nirāso anāsisāno'ti yassa ariyamaggena vināsitattā anusayā ca na santi, akusalamūlā ca samūhatā, so nirāso nittaṇho hoti. tato āsāya abhāvena kañci rūp'ādidhammaṃ n'āsīsati. ten'āha nirāso anāsisāno'ti.

examples.text: yass'ānusayā na santi keci, mūlā ca akusalā samūhatāse, so nirāso anāsisāno, sammā so loke paribbajeyya.

75182.meaning1: who has destroyed the effluents; epithet of an arahant

examples.text: āsavakhīṇo pahīnamāno, sabbaṃ rāgapathaṃ upātivatto, danto parinibbuto ṭhit'atto, sammā so loke paribbajeyya.

75183.meaning1: seeing certainty; understanding the fixed order; knowing the right way
75183.commentary: (SNPa) niyāmadassī'ti saṃsārakantāramūḷhe loke amatapuragāmino sammattaniyāmabhūtassa maggassa dassāvī, diṭṭhamaggo'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: saddho sutavā niyāmadassī, vaggagatesu na vaggasāri dhīro, lobhaṃ dosaṃ vineyya paṭighaṃ, sammā so loke paribbajeyya.
saṃsuddhajino vivaṭṭacchado, dhammesu vasī pāragū anejo, saṅkhāranirodhañāṇakusalo, sammā so loke paribbajeyya.

75185.meaning1: skilled in the understanding of the cessation of conditions
75185.commentary: (SNPa) saṅkhāranirodhañāṇakusalo'ti saṅkhāranirodho vuccati nibbānaṃ, tamhi ñāṇaṃ ariyamaggapaññā, tattha kusalo, catukkhattuṃ bhāvitattā cheko'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: saṃsuddhajino vivaṭṭacchado, dhammesu vasī pāragū anejo, saṅkhāranirodhañāṇakusalo, sammā so loke paribbajeyya.

75186.commentary: (SNPa) kapp'ātīto'ti ahaṃ maman'ti kappanaṃ sabbam'pi vā taṇhādiṭṭhikappaṃ atīto.

examples.text: atītesu anāgatesu c'āpi, kapp'ātīto aticcasuddhipañño, sabb'āyatanehi vippamutto, sammā so loke paribbajeyya.

75187.meaning1: having perfectly pure wisdom; with exceedingly clear understanding
75187.commentary: (SNPa) aticca suddhipañño'ti atīva suddhipañño, atikkamitvā vā suddhipañño. kiṃ atikkamitvā? addhattayaṃ. arahā hi yv'āyaṃ avijjāsaṅkhārasaṅkhāto atīto addhā, jātijarāmaraṇasaṅkhāto anāgato addhā, viññāṇ'ādibhavapariyanto paccuppanno ca addhā, taṃ sabbam'pi atikkamma kaṅkhaṃ vitaritvā paramasuddhippattapañño hutvā ṭhito. tena vuccati aticca suddhipañño'ti.

examples.text: atītesu anāgatesu c'āpi, kapp'ātīto aticcasuddhipañño, sabb'āyatanehi vippamutto, sammā so loke paribbajeyya.

75188.meaning1: all sense bases and fields; all the senses

examples.text: atītesu anāgatesu c'āpi, kapp'ātīto aticcasuddhipañño, sabb'āyatanehi vippamutto, sammā so loke paribbajeyya.

75189.commentary: (SNPa) sabb'upadhīnaṃ parikkhayā'ti sabbesaṃ khandha-kāmaguṇa-kiles'ābhisaṅkhāra-bhedānaṃ upadhīnaṃ parikkhīṇattā katthaci asajjamāno bhikkhu

examples.text: aññāya padaṃ samecca dhammaṃ, vivaṭaṃ disvāna pahānam'āsavānaṃ, sabb'upadhīnaṃ parikkhayāno, sammā so loke paribbajeyya.

75190.meaning1: left behind all fetters and bonds; transcended all chains and ties

examples.text: addhā hi bhagavā tath'eva etaṃ, yo so evaṃvihārī danto bhikkhu, sabbasaṃyojanayogavītivatto, sammā so loke paribbajeyyā'ti.

75191.meaning1: thing which fetters; something which chains
75191.construction:
saṃ + yoje + ana + iya
saṃyojana + iya

examples.text: addhā hi bhagavā tath'eva etaṃ, yo so evaṃvihārī danto bhikkhu, sabbasaṃyojaniye ca vītivatto, sammā so loke paribbajeyyā'ti.

75192.meaning1: all things which fetter; everything conducive to bondage

examples.text: addhā hi bhagavā tath'eva etaṃ, yo so evaṃvihārī danto bhikkhu, sabbasaṃyojaniye ca vītivatto, sammā so loke paribbajeyyā'ti.

75193.synonym: attamana, abhiraddha, avighātavant, āraddhacitta, tuṭṭhi, somanassajāta
75193.commentary: (SNPa) sādhū'ti sutvāna patītarūpo'ti taṃ pañhaṃ sutvā sādhu bhante'ti abhinanditvā tuṭṭharūpo gato'ti attho. (JAa) patītarūpā'ti somanassajātā.

examples.text: āgañchi te santike nāgarājā, erāvaṇo nāma jino'ti sutvā, so'pi tayā mantayitv'ājjhagamā, sādhū'ti sutvāna patītarūpo.

75194.meaning1: asking about; questioning; enquiring; interrogating (somebody about)

examples.text: rājā'pi taṃ vessavaṇo kuvero, upeti dhammaṃ paripucchamāno, tassā'pi tvaṃ pucchito brūsi dhīra, so c'āpi sutvāna patītarūpo.
buddho'ti ghosaṃ yada parato suṇāsi, sambodhipatto vivarati dhammam'aggaṃ, gantvāna tattha samayaṃ paripucchamāno, carassu tasmiṃ bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ.

75195.meaning1: in the habit of arguing; accustomed to debating
75195.commentary: (SNPa) ye kec'ime titthiyā vādasīlā'ti, mayaṃ sammā paṭipannā, aññe micchā paṭipannā'ti evaṃ vādakaraṇasīlā lokaṃ mukhasattīhi vitudantā vicaranti.

examples.text: ye kec'ime titthiyā vādasīlā, ājīvakā vā yadi vā nigaṇṭhā, paññāya taṃ n'ātitaranti sabbe, ṭhito vajantaṃ viya sīghagāmiṃ.

75196.grammar: pr, from na atitarati, neg, trans (+acc)
75196.meaning1: does not cross beyond; does not transcend; does not overcome
75196.construction:
na + ati + tara + ti
na + atitarati

examples.text: ye kec'ime titthiyā vādasīlā, ājīvakā vā yadi vā nigaṇṭhā, paññāya taṃ n'ātitaranti sabbe, ṭhito vajantaṃ viya sīghagāmiṃ.

75197.meaning1: well said; well spoken; correctly declared

examples.text: ayañ'hi dhammo nipuṇo sukho ca, yo'yaṃ tayā bhagavā suppavutto, tam'eva sabbe'pi sussūsamānā, taṃ no vada pucchito buddhaseṭṭha.

75198.meaning1: wanting to hear; wishing to listen to

examples.text: ayañ'hi dhammo nipuṇo sukho ca, yo'yaṃ tayā bhagavā suppavutto, tam'eva sabbe'pi sussūsamānā, taṃ no vada pucchito buddhaseṭṭha.

75199.grammar: imp 2nd pl of carati, irreg form of caratha, trans (+acc)
75199.commentary: (SNPa) dhammaṃ dhutaṃ tañ'ca carātha sabbe'ti kilese dhunātī'ti dhuto, evarūpaṃ kilesadhunanakaṃ paṭipadādhammaṃ sāvayāmi vo, tañ'ca mayā sāvitaṃ sabbe caratha paṭipajjatha, mā pamāditthā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: suṇātha me bhikkhavo sāvayāmi vo, dhammaṃ dhutaṃ tañ'ca carātha sabbe, iriyāpathaṃ pabbajit'ānulomikaṃ, sevetha naṃ atthadaso mutīmā.
